exact.La pointe prend la houle d'ouest en prem: The point is the first to pick up westerly swell: a fast, hollow right-hander over reef. For kite and wing, launch from whichever sandy cove best matches the wind direction.
exact.Rochers partout, fond très peu profond,: Rocks everywhere, very shallow bottom, gusts near the cliffs. North-easterly wind: offshore, dangerous to get back in.
exact.Petite crique entre les falaises, au sud: Small cove between the cliffs, south of the village. Reef wave with a west to south-west swell, best with a north to north-east wind.
exact.Récif découvert à marée basse, courants,: Reef exposed at low tide, currents, unsupervised bathing. Too small to launch a kite.
exact.Grande plage de sable. Beach break par h: Long sandy beach. Beach break with a westerly swell; kite and wing at the north end, near the La Cormorane sailing centre.
exact.Shorebreak à marée haute, pêcheries. Du: Shorebreak at high tide, fishing huts. From 15 June to 15 September (and weekends from May to September): go out through the marked channels, beyond 300 m.
exact.Bancs de sable et vagues faciles : le sp: Sandbanks and easy waves: Saint-Brevin's learn-to-surf spot (schools on the beach in July–August). For kite and wing, one of the few spots open in summer, in the marked corridor; best wind west to north-west.
exact.Spot très fréquenté, baigneurs et surfeu: Very busy spot, swimmers and surfers in the same area; small rock slabs at low tide on big coefficients; marked plover nesting areas. High season (15 June–15 September, plus weekends and public holidays from 1 May to 30 September): kiting only between allée des Bouillons and allée des Pâquerettes, beyond the first 50 metres; surf outside the supervised bathing areas.
exact.Plan d'eau abrité de la houle, de la Gra: Stretch of water sheltered from the swell, from the Grande Plage in Préfailles to La Noëveillard (Pornic). Sailing and paddleboarding; kiting at Le Cormier (La Plaine), with a school on site.
exact.Parcs à huîtres et rochers à la marée de: Oyster beds and rocks on the falling tide, boat traffic from Pornic harbour. North to north-east wind: offshore.
exact.Base nautique (centre nautique municipal: Watersports base (municipal sailing centre, kite and wing schools), large sandbanks where you can stand at low tide. The place to learn kite and wing, and the starting point for catamarans, windsurfing and paddleboarding. Best wind: south-west to west.
exact.Interdit aux pratiquants libres de kite/: Closed to independent kite/wing riders from 15 June to 15 September and at weekends and on public holidays from 1 May to 30 September (reserved for schools between avenue Roger and chemin de la Marine, 24 kites maximum). Do not launch near the sea wall or the car park wall; outgoing current depending on the tide; 30 m marked channel in front of the west slipway (no sailing or anchoring); fast windsurfers. Motorboats banned off the beach from avenue Roger to avenue de la Brévinière.
exact.Grande plage où l'école de surf donne re: Long beach where the surf school meets (lifeguard station, at the end of allée André). Small, regular waves from mid tide to high tide. For kiting, fairly flat water at low tide, shore waves at high tide; best wind: north-west.
exact.Souvent vent de mer et petit shorebreak: Often an onshore wind and a small shorebreak at high tide. Fixed posts joined by wire around the plover nesting area (downwind). Water quality sometimes poor in summer (the Boivre stream): swimming may be banned. High season: respect the school and bathing zones; motorboats banned from avenue Alexandre-Bernard to allée André.
exact.Côté nord de la pointe, face à l'estuair: North side of the point, facing the estuary. The go-to spot when a west to north-west wind makes the south coast too exposed.
exact.Courants de l'estuaire, pêcheries, sable: Estuary currents, fishing huts, sand and rocks. South to east wind: offshore, don't go out.
exact.Spot de vagues pour kite et planche, en: Wave spot for kiting and windsurfing, on the edge of Saint-Michel-Chef-Chef, by the Pierre Attelée forest. Best wind: south-south-west.
exact.Rochers et hauts-fonds nombreux, fort co: Many rocks and shallows, strong sideways current on the rising tide, shorebreak, fishing huts; the wind is disturbed by the low cliff as soon as it has any south in it. Kiting banned from 15 June to 15 September and at weekends and on public holidays from 1 May to 30 September.
exact.Les bonnes marées des prochaines semaine: Good tides over the coming weeks, calculated for Préfailles.
exact.Pas de bonne marée de jour dans les deux: No good daytime tides in the next two months.
exact.Coefficient 70 et plus, basse mer entre: Coefficient 70 or more, low tide between 7h and 19h. The time slot runs from 1 h 15 before to 1 h 15 after low tide.
exact.Regardez l'heure de la basse mer avant d: Check the time of low tide before you set off and head back as soon as the tide turns: on big coefficients it comes back in fast.
exact.Repérez votre chemin de retour. Les chen: Keep track of your way back. Channels and hollows fill up first and can cut you off from the shore.
exact.N'y allez pas seul, prévenez quelqu'un,: Don't go alone, tell someone where you're going, and keep a charged phone in a waterproof pouch.
exact.Chaussures fermées : rochers glissants e: Wear closed shoes: slippery rocks and sharp shells.
exact.Brouillard, orage ou vent qui forcit : o: Fog, a storm or a strengthening wind: head back straight away.
exact.Remettez les rochers retournés à leur pl: Put any rocks you turn over back in place, and only take what you will eat.

exact.Touchez un endroit de la carte pour conn: Tap a spot on the map to see its zoning.
exact.Pour afficher la météo, le vent, la houl: To show the weather, wind, swell and water temperature, your phone queries Open-Meteo directly (open-meteo.com, data under CC BY 4.0 licence, models from Météo-France, the European centre ECMWF, the German service DWD and the American NOAA): so this service sees your IP address, like any website you visit. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which also sees your IP address. Audience totals are sent to a counter hosted by Cloudflare. The restaurant map is drawn on an OpenStreetMap background (tile.openstreetmap.org), loaded only when you open the map. Some opening hours also come from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL licence). On the Property map, the address you type is sent to the State's address service (api-adresse.data.gouv.fr), only when you run the search. The Land register and Zoning layers, the zone of a tapped spot and plot outlines come from IGN services (data.geopf.fr, apicarto.ign.fr), called only when you use them. The marine weather forecast comes from Météo-France (meteofrance.com) and the measured swell from the Plateau du Four buoy, Cerema's Candhis network (Licence Ouverte Etalab).
exact.Touchez une année pour voir tous ses per: Tap a year to see all its permits, as a list and on the map.
exact.Touchez une vignette pour voir les adres: Tap a tile to see addresses and phone numbers, nearest first.
exact.Touchez une vignette pour les horaires e: Tap a tile for opening hours and the phone number.
exact.En mer ou sur l'estran: At sea or on the foreshore
exact.Un mardi sur deux ; chaque mardi l'été: Every other Tuesday; every Tuesday in summer
exact.Touchez une parcelle ou un point violet: Tap a plot or a purple dot for details.
exact.Dans quelle zone est mon adresse ?: Which zone is my address in?

exact.Prix du milieu : la moitié des ventes au: Median: half of sales above, half below.
exact.Écartez deux doigts pour zoomer : les pr: Pinch to zoom in: prices appear on the plots.
exact.Avant tout projet, demandez un certifica: Before any project, ask the town hall for a planning certificate.
exact.Touchez une année pour voir ses permis,: Tap a year to see its permits, as a list and on the map.
exact.On ne construit que dans les zones urbai: Building is only allowed in urban zones and zones to be developed; the rest is agricultural or natural. For your address: “Around my address”, at the top of the page.
